answer.worked:
Reflect in both axes by replacing $x$ by $-x$ and $y$ by $-y$.
$$\begin{align*}-y&=-x-\cos(-x)\\-y&=-x-\cos x\\y&=x+\cos x\end{align*}$$
Each point $(x,y)$ maps to $(-x,-y)$. In particular, $(0,-1)$ becomes $(0,1)$. Rotate the supplied increasing curve through $180^\circ$ about the origin, retaining its flatter regions and end directions.
